sections.heading: The infrastructure under every build.
sections.lede: Every TANCHES.GG room sits on enterprise infrastructure: structured cabling, a managed network, local servers, and endpoint security. Here is what goes into a build and why each piece matters.

sections.heading: We start with the infrastructure.
body: Most esports vendors start with the gaming PCs. We start with the infrastructure, and we design every build with the same enterprise practices we have used in IT environments for 28 years.

That gives you a room that works on day one and holds up for years. If you need the full build, we do that. If you only need the right hardware for your space, we do that too, at whatever scope makes sense for you.

interactive.caption: Ten layers make up a finished facility. Open one to see what it covers and why it matters.
interactive.behaviour: One layer open at a time; clicking the open one closes it. Panel shows desc, then 'Why it matters.' (bold) followed by why.

items.name: Facility Design
items.desc: Space planning, power, HVAC, lighting, furniture, and finishes, designed around how the room will actually be used.
items.why: Every other layer lives inside the room. Getting power, cooling, and layout right up front prevents costly rework later.

items.name: Structured Cabling
items.desc: Certified copper and fiber runs, patch panels, and cable management, labeled and documented to standard.
items.why: Cabling is the hardest thing to change once the walls close. A clean plant supports today’s gear and the next two refresh cycles.

items.name: Enterprise Networking
items.desc: Managed switching, segmented VLANs, wireless, and QoS tuned for low-latency competitive play.
items.why: Lag and packet loss decide matches. A purpose-built network keeps gaming traffic fast and isolated from the rest of campus.

items.name: Server Infrastructure
items.desc: Local compute and storage for game caching, image deployment, and management tools.
items.why: Machines get re-imaged and patched in minutes instead of hours, and updates don’t saturate your internet connection.

items.name: Cybersecurity
items.desc: Endpoint protection, application control, firewall policy, and threat monitoring.
items.why: Gaming PCs are high-value targets on your network. Locking them down protects students, data, and the rest of your environment.

items.name: Gaming Hardware
items.desc: Workstations, displays, and peripherals sourced through our OEM partnerships and configured for your titles.
items.why: The right spec holds steady frame rates for years, so the program isn’t forced into an early refresh.

items.name: AV & Streaming
items.desc: Displays, audio, control systems, and broadcast workflows for casting, events, and streaming.
items.why: AV turns a computer lab into a venue that can host matches, events, and broadcasts, which grows the program’s visibility.

items.name: Managed Services & Lab Ops
items.desc: Session and billing management, monitoring, patching, and support after deployment.
items.why: Facilities fail when no one owns them. Managed ops keep the space running so staff can focus on players.

items.name: Curriculum
items.desc: STEM-accredited esports curriculum and programming that connects gameplay to career pathways.
items.why: Curriculum is what turns a gaming room into an educational asset, and it helps justify funding.

items.name: League
items.desc: Organized competition, scheduling, and seasons that give players something to train for.
items.why: Competition drives engagement and retention. It keeps the facility in daily use long after opening day.

sections.heading: What we can take on
sections.lede: The layers above are what a facility is made of. These are the services we deliver them through, from a single equipment deployment to a full build.

cards.title: Advisory & Planning
cards.body: We assess your space, goals, and constraints before you commit to anything, and tell you plainly what you need and what you don’t.

cards.title: Grants Research
cards.body: We find grants, MDF, and co-funding that can offset or fully cover the cost of your build, and help you go after them.

cards.title: Facility Design
cards.body: Space planning, lighting, furniture, and finishes, built around how the room will be used and how it should feel.

cards.title: Cabling & Networking
cards.body: Structured cabling, enterprise switching, wireless, and network configuration, built for performance and room to grow.

cards.title: AV Integration
cards.body: Extron AV design, display systems, control panels, and broadcast infrastructure, designed and commissioned by certified integrators.

cards.title: Gaming Hardware & Servers
cards.body: Workstations, peripherals, displays, and servers, sourced through our OEM partnerships and configured for your environment.

cards.title: Curriculum & Programming
cards.body: STEM-accredited esports curriculum and programming support, so the facility is used for teaching as well as play.

cards.title: Ongoing Support
cards.body: Endpoint protection, threat monitoring, lab operations, and IT support. We manage the whole post-deployment layer so your team can focus on the program.

sections.heading: We pick hardware for the job, not the brand.
sections.headingHtml: We pick hardware for the job, not the brand.
body: We hold metallic-tier partnerships with leading manufacturers. That gets you better pricing, priority support, and access to current hardware. We are vendor-agnostic, so we spec what fits your environment, your budget, and your goals.
